name: Isolated AC-DC converter
description: Offline isolated supply: mains input section plus a flyback/LLC stage with a safety-rated transformer and optocoupler feedback.
electrical_characteristics: Reinforced insulation for SELV outputs touched by users
Primary ground is hazardous; secondary is SELV
Y capacitor across the barrier for EMI
critical_electrical_constraints: Barrier creepage per the insulation grade (reinforced = 2x basic) with the transformer and opto as the only bridges
Slot in the board where the distance cannot be met
Secondary ground never connected to primary except through the Y capacitor
stackup_recommendations: Single or double sided FR-4 with the isolation barrier as a physical slot or an unbroken creepage distance
Thicker board (1.6 mm) for mechanical and dielectric robustness
placement_rules: Primary and secondary sides physically separated by the isolation barrier; only isolating components (transformer, optocoupler, Y-capacitor) bridge it
Fuse first in the path after the mains input connector; MOV/TVS across the input after the fuse
No low-voltage logic within the creepage distance of mains nets
Mains connectors and relays at a board edge with the enclosure clearance in mind
routing_rules: Mains traces sized for the inrush and the fuse let-through, not only the RMS current
Creepage and clearance from IEC 60664-1 for the working voltage, pollution degree and material group (desk.ipc)
No vias in the isolation barrier; slot the board where creepage cannot be met
Keep gate-drive and control traces away from mains edges
copper_ground_requirements: No ground pour across the isolation barrier
Copper setback from board edge on mains nets per the enclosure's accessible-surface rules
thermal_considerations: Bleeder, snubber and dropper resistors dissipate continuously: compute and derate at 60-70 % of rating
Rectifier and switching devices need copper or heatsinking sized for the full load
emi_emc_considerations: X and Y capacitors and common-mode choke placement per the EMI filter topology
Y-capacitor return to the protective earth or secondary ground as the safety standard permits
protection_requirements: Fuse, MOV, inrush limiter, and where required a GDT; creepage and clearance verified for the overvoltage category
Double or reinforced insulation across the barrier per IEC 62368-1 / 60335-1 as applicable
verification_requirements: Every mains and HV net declared in voltage_rails (unknown voltage blocks clearance derivation)
Creepage/clearance table per net pair recorded in the design profile
Isolation barrier verified as a keep-out on all layers
Dielectric strength (hipot) test plan recorded; this is a hardware-validation item, not an offline check
manufacturing_constraints: Slot or routed gap for the isolation barrier in the outline
Solder-mask-defined spacing noted; conformal coating changes the clearance condition (B4) and must be declared
unsupported_conditions: Basic insulation where reinforced is required

maturity.evidence: rule set evaluated against synthetic fixtures in tests/test_cross_domain_cases.py
maturity.reviewed_by: DESK engineering (automated generation, pending human review)
